thread:
Alex K.: quick handoff — I'm going offline at 18:00 PT. Primary for the next 8h is @Maya S., secondary is @Liam R. I'm leaving notes on access and gaps below.

Maya S.: thanks — taking primary. Can you confirm I have PagerDuty and Grafana access? I can't escalate from my phone this morning. :grimacing:

Alex K.: good callout. Checklist I ran before leaving: PagerDuty mobile app signed in, PagerDuty web user in escalation policy "prod-inference", Grafana org role = Editor, AWS SSO mapped to infra-admin role for emergency console access.

Oncall Bot: INCIDENT HANDOFF: root=1769547890; severity=info; previous_primary=Alex K.; new_primary=Maya S.; new_secondary=Liam R.; runbook=https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff

Maya S.: I tried `pd users:list --query "Maya S."` on my laptop and it returned my account, but when I open the PD mobile app it shows "limited access". Could be a SSO token issue.

Liam R.: if mobile is funky, web should work. Also check the PD escalations page: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/escalation_policies/P12345 — you should be listed in the first 2 steps.

Alex K.: Maya — quick steps to self-check: 1) open PD web, confirm you can see incidents and the escalation policy; 2) try to trigger a test alert (non-prod) from the runbook; 3) confirm mobile push notifications are enabled. If mobile still fails, we can open an SSO refresh ticket with IDP.

Maya S.: PD web shows me in the policy but the mobile app is old version. Updating now. Also can someone confirm Grafana? I need dashboard edit to mute alerts if we need to during incidents.

Liam R.: Grafana: go to https://grafana.redwood.io/org/users and find your email. Role must be Editor or Admin for alert muting. If you only see "Viewer", open a ticket to eng-infra slack channel with subject: "grafana-role-change" and include the grafana user id.

Alex K.: copy of my quick commands for access proofs: ```bash
# check AWS console mapping
aws sts get-caller-identity --profile maya-sso
# should return account and user id

# check pagerduty via CLI
pd users:get --id `pd users:list --query "Maya S." --output json | jq -r '.[0].id'`
```
If any of those fail, ping me on signal or escalate to infra.

Maya S.: did the AWS check — `aws sts get-caller-identity` returned an ARN but trying `aws s3 ls` got AccessDenied. Probably not mapped to infra-admin role. Jordan (ops) set up my SSO last month, @Jordan T. can you confirm role mapping?

Jordan T.: looks like a stale permission. I just checked the SSO mapping for `maya.s@redwood.com` — she had `redwood-infra:ReadOnly` instead of `infra-admin`. I can swap it but need approval from security for elevation. I'll open a ticket to security with justification: temporary on-call elevation for 8h.

Maya S.: ack. If security approval takes long, what are mitigation options?

Alex K.: options: 1) use PagerDuty web to ack and escalate (still works for most things); 2) request Liam (secondary) to perform any console actions requiring infra-admin; 3) if it's a critical incident needing quicker console access, we can request an emergency break-glass via the SRE rotation account — see runbook section "break-glass-procedure" at https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff#break-glass-procedure.

Oncall Bot: REMINDER: ensure replacement on-call has access to PD, AWS, Grafana or explicit documented fallback.

Liam R.: I can be the console operator for the first 2 hours if security doesn't approve fast. I have infra-admin via SSO. If there's any scaling or pod restarts needed, ping me and I'll take it.

Maya S.: thanks Liam — appreciate it. Jordan, can you note estimated ETA for ticket?

Jordan T.: ticket created SEC-4572, tagged urgent for 8h temporary elevation, ETA ~25-40 minutes typically during business hours but might be slower off-hours. I'll DM you the ticket link.

Alex K.: for future handoffs, small recommendation: add a short table to handoff messages with three checks: PD mobile signed in, Grafana role confirmed, AWS console access tested. Keeps handoffs consistent.

Maya S.: agreed — can we add that to the runbook? I'll open a PR to the runbook to add the checklist and an example commands snippet.

Jordan T.: done on the ticket: security approved temporary infra-admin elevation for 6 hours starting now. Maya, you should be able to re-run `aws sso login --profile maya-sso` and assume infra-admin.

Maya S.: re-logged in and `aws s3 ls` now works. Confirmed Grafana Editor role already existed so I can mute alerts if needed. PD mobile updated and now receiving pushes. All set.

Alex K.: perfect. Final notes: primary=Maya S., secondary=Liam R., coverage gap: none now (Jordan handled quick SSO fix). Runbook link again for anyone: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff. If anything odd, annotate the incident with access steps taken. Thank you! :rocket:

Maya S.: thanks Alex — taking it from here.
